headline: Gold.com, Inc. CEO Compensation Disclosed in SEC Filing
summary: A recent SEC filing reveals the 2026 compensation for Gold.com, Inc. CEO Gregory Roberts.

headline: Agnico Eagle Announces 1.5 Million Ounce Annual Production Growth Plan by 2030
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. has outlined a strategic growth plan to increase production by approximately 1.5 million ounces per year by 2030, supported by key assets including Detour Lake, Canadian Malartic, Hope Bay, and Upper Beaver.

headline: Franco-Nevada Issues Long-Term Gold-Equivalent Ounce Growth Guidance
summary: Franco-Nevada projects steady growth in gold-equivalent ounces (GEOs) over the next decade, with potential for a 45% increase in five-year growth contingent on the restart of the Cobre Panama mine.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Reports Initial Assay Results from 2026 Drilling at Yarumalito Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. announced initial assay results from its 2026 diamond core drilling program at the Yarumalito Project in Colombia, confirming wide intervals of gold-copper porphyry-style mineralization.

headline: StrikePoint Gold Completes Acquisition of Northumberland Gold Project from Newmont
summary: StrikePoint Gold Inc. has finalized its acquisition of the Northumberland Gold Project from Newmont Corporation.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals to Release 2026 Third Quarter Results on November 5, 2026
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has scheduled the release of its 2026 third-quarter financial results for November 5, 2026, following the market close.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Subsidiary Spectrum Wine Auctions Acquires Wine Cellar Club
summary: Gold.com, Inc. announced that its majority-owned subsidiary, Spectrum Wine Auctions LLC, has acquired the Orange County-based Wine Cellar Club to expand its storage capacity.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Provides Nevada Development Plan Update
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. announced an update on its Nevada mining projects, confirming that its development plan remains on track to reach an annual production target of 150,000 to 200,000 ounces of gold by 2028.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Appoints Alexandre Soares Pimenta as Project Director for São Jorge Gold Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has appointed Alexandre Soares Pimenta as Project Director to lead the advancement of its 100%-owned São Jorge Gold Project in Brazil.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Participates in Luca Mining's C$56.4 Million Private Placement
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. invested C$35.2 million to acquire subscription receipts as part of a concurrent private placement supporting Luca Mining's acquisition of the Cozamin mine.

headline: Hudbay Minerals Announces Funding Plan for Copper World Project Including Wheaton Precious Metals Stream
summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. announced a definitive project funding plan for its Copper World project, which includes a $230 million deposit from Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. for an existing precious metals stream.

headline: Hudbay Minerals Announces Results of Definitive Feasibility Study for Copper World Project
summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. announced the results of a definitive feasibility study for its Copper World project, which includes a $230 million precious metals streaming deposit from Wheaton Precious Metals Corp.

headline: Hudbay and Mitsubishi Approve Construction of Copper World Project with Wheaton Precious Metals Streaming Agreement
summary: Hudbay Minerals and Mitsubishi have approved the construction of the Copper World project in Arizona, which includes a $230 million precious metals streaming deposit from Wheaton Precious Metals.

headline: i-80 Gold Announces Details for Q3 2026 Results Release and Conference Call
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. has scheduled the release of its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026 for November 2, 2026.

headline: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited Invests $1 Million in W2 Critical Minerals Corp.
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has invested $1 million in W2 Critical Minerals Corp., a subsidiary of White Gold Corp., as part of a private placement offering.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Schedules Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Earnings Conference Call
summary: Gold.com, Inc. has announced it will host a conference call on November 4, 2026, to discuss its financial results for the fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Randy Smallwood Appointed to Snowline Gold Corp. Board of Directors
summary: Randy Smallwood, the non-executive Chair of Wheaton Precious Metals Corp., has been appointed as an independent director to the board of Snowline Gold Corp.

headline: White Gold Corp. Reports 2026 Drill Results with Strategic Support from Agnico Eagle
summary: White Gold Corp. announced results from its 2026 diamond drill program, which is supported by its major shareholder, Agnico Eagle Mines Limited.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Commences Pre-Feasibility Study and Infill Drilling at São Jorge Gold Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has initiated a Pre-Feasibility Study and a 6,000-metre infill diamond core drilling program at its 100%-owned São Jorge Gold Project in Brazil.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Reports Record First-Half 2026 Performance
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals achieved record production, revenue, earnings, and cash flow for the first half of 2026, supported by strong gold and silver prices.
